image_description: A small, slender snake with smooth, glossy scales is coiled in the palm of a human hand. The snake has a golden-bronze dorsal coloration and a pale cream/white ventral side. Its head is small with a visible dark eye and a rounded snout. The background consists of the blurred skin texture of the hand holding the snake.
